text: Completed P5 and all acceptance criteria. Evidence: Ravel testAllFull plus representationProof passed with 75 JVM core tests, 77 Node core tests, 2 reusable-laws tests per platform, 3 real-Chromium tests, and full optimized Scala.js links. Generated properties run 250 cases each for shapes, composed views, broadcasting, and mutable locality. JVM/JS borrowed interop and dtype-specific descriptors pass alias/copy/layout tests. Artifact POM/jar/eviction audit confirms only ravel-core and ravel-laws are publishable with intended dependency scopes. OPEN-003 is resolved with checked-in contiguous/strided budgets; JMH records 6,748/6,646 public ops/s and one output allocation. Sibling Gale interopRavelTest passed 4 JVM and 4 Scala.js tests for the publishable copy-only gale-interop-ravel module. Scope audit found no Gale semantics in ravel-core. Documentation covers NumPy migration and all copy/view/borrow/mutation/cast/reduction/equality contracts. Deviation: the Ravel workspace has no .git metadata, so no Ravel implementation commit hash exists; sibling Gale adapter changes are present but intentionally uncommitted because commit/publish was not requested.
